scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:tooling
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:app && npm run build:bundle
scripts.build:itch: npm run typecheck:app && npm run build:bundle -- --base ./
scripts.test:theory: vitest run src/components/__tests__/TheoryPanel.test.tsx src/components/theory src/data/__tests__/theory-data.test.ts src/data/__tests__/hamming-data.test.ts src/data/__tests__/boolean-color-algebra.test.ts src/i18n/__tests__/theory-copy.test.ts src/i18n/__tests__/i18n-keys.test.ts src/__tests__/chromalum-color-model.test.ts src/__tests__/research-note-invariants.test.ts --testTimeout=15000
scripts.lint: eslint src e2e scripts eslint.config.mjs vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.pwa.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src e2e scripts/**/*.mjs .github AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/**/*.md *.html public/*.webmanifest .lintstagedrc.json tsconfig*.json playwright.config.ts playwright.pwa.config.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src e2e scripts/**/*.mjs .github AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/**/*.md *.html public/*.webmanifest .lintstagedrc.json tsconfig*.json playwright.config.ts playwright.pwa.config.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.verify:theory: npm run typecheck:app && npm run test:theory
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run deadcode && npm run typecheck:all && npm run build:bundle && npm test
scripts.verify:prepush: npm run typecheck:app && npm run lint
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:pwa
scripts.verify:full: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run deadcode && npm run typecheck:all && npm run build:bundle && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:pwa
